fact: The November 2020 interim evaluation reports that DCCMS forecasters can now integrate numerical weather products with satellite-based information on a new weather data integration and processing system installed under the GCF/UNDP project, and that short-term forecasts reached 10,527 farmers by SMS in 10 districts.
title: Interim Evaluation: Saving Lives and Protecting Agriculture-based Livelihoods in Malawi: Scaling Up the Use of Modernized Climate Information and Early Warnings Systems
publisher: UNDP / Government of Malawi (Aldababseh and Kamoto)
